svg.aria-label: Exact one-dimensional Gaussian ELBO and reparameterization
svg.title: Exact one-dimensional Gaussian ELBO and reparameterization
svg.desc: The approximate posterior, exact posterior and prior are density curves. A fixed epsilon gives one reparameterized value, while the ELBO is computed in closed form.

g.text: Changing epsilon moves the marker; the exact expected ELBO stays unchanged.
